author: ValWood
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**


GO:0043935 | sexual sporulation resulting in formation of a cellular spore | IEA with ARBA00086620

GO:0048468 | cell development | IEA with ARBA00028665


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC926.07c

* **Description of issue**

Dynein's direct function in S. pombe is driving the horse-tail nuclear oscillations during meiotic prophase promoting proper homologous chromosome pairing and recombination. The sporulation defects (aberrant asci with fewer than four spores) are a downstream consequence of impaired chromosome segregation

title: ARBA2GO issue: ARBA00086620 not GO:0043935 | sexual sporulation resulting in formation of a cellular spore

author: Antonialock
body: this is because the gene was annotated to ":ascospore formation", a gene from A. nidulans in the same funfam was also annotated to a similar term and they were both the master entries for this ARBA annotation. - I removed the annotation from nidulans and the pombe annotation was also removed  so the ARBA will disappear
